Entry Female Right of Lordship In most areas of Westeros, male inheritance is preferred, but women can still hold land and power due to being an only daughter, widowed, regent, or family arrangement. Laws are one thing, local customs and armed support are another; every female lord has to face constant questioning of her Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.

Entry Female Right of Lordship In most areas of Westeros, male inheritance is preferred, but women can still hold land and power due to being an only daughter, widowed, regent, or family arrangement. Laws are one thing, local customs and armed support are another; every female lord has to face constant questioning of her If a rule is practiced over and over again, it will find its way into rituals, crafts, and prayers; if it is sustained only by fear, cracks will show at the onset of a crisis.
